user.title: Meltem Modbus
user.description: Set up the M-WRG-GW and its units in the Meltem app first. Choose USB serial, raw RTU over TCP, or Modbus TCP (MBAP). Network connections have no encryption or authentication; use a trusted local network only.

init.title: Configure Meltem Modbus
init.description: Choose whether to change the request rate or to scan the gateway for new, moved, or removed units. To change the profile of a single unit, use Reconfigure on that unit.

edit_request_rate.title: Change request rate
edit_request_rate.description: Set the shared cap for Modbus read requests across all configured units. Poll-job starts are also limited to this rate; one job can contain several read requests. Retries and post-write readbacks count toward the request cap. To change the serial port, reconfigure the integration.

data_description.max_requests_per_second: Maximum rate for individual read requests across all units, including retries and post-write readbacks. Poll-job starts are also limited to this rate; write sequences use separate hardware timing.

rescan_units.title: Scan for new Meltem M-WRG units

missing_humidity_extract_air.title: {unit}: extract air humidity is not reported
missing_humidity_extract_air.description:
The profile {profile} of {unit} includes an extract air humidity sensor, but the unit keeps reporting that no reading is available, so the sensor shows unknown.

Check that the profile selected for the unit matches its type plate, and reconfigure the unit if it does not. If the profile is correct, the sensor may be faulty. This message disappears once the unit reports a value again.

missing_humidity_supply_air.title: {unit}: supply air humidity is not reported
missing_humidity_supply_air.description:
The profile {profile} of {unit} includes a supply air humidity sensor, but the unit keeps reporting that no reading is available, so the sensor shows unknown.

Check that the profile selected for the unit matches its type plate, and reconfigure the unit if it does not. If the profile is correct, the sensor may be faulty. This message disappears once the unit reports a value again.

missing_co2_extract_air.title: {unit}: extract air CO2 is not reported
missing_co2_extract_air.description:

new_units_found.title: The Meltem gateway reports units that are not set up
new_units_found.description:
The gateway reports {count} Meltem M-WRG units that Home Assistant does not have yet, at Modbus address {addresses}.

To add them, open the Meltem Modbus integration and choose **Add unit**, or run **Scan for new units** in its options. The profile cannot be detected reliably, so you choose it from the type plate of each unit. This message disappears once every unit the gateway reports is set up.
